answer: At violet dusk a falcon leaves the glove over basalt moorland, and the registry notes the bird. An agent registers one falcon and one stretch of moor, earns its licence by exam and supervised season, and flies it once per epoch for any licensed falconer to challenge. Forging one identity means training another falcon and licensing another falconer, so one hundred fakes need one hundred licences at $480 each, $48,000 before any attests.
